from cfg.loader import load_config

# Test basic
defaults = {'port': 80, 'host': 'localhost', 'debug': False, 'ratio': 1.0}
env = {
    'APP_PORT': '8080',
    'APP_HOST': '0.0.0.0',
    'APP_DEBUG': 'true',
    'APP_RATIO': '2.5',
    'APP_UNKNOWN': 'value',
    'OTHER_PORT': '9999',
}
res = load_config(defaults, env)
assert res == {'port': 8080, 'host': '0.0.0.0', 'debug': True, 'ratio': 2.5}

# Test bool false
assert load_config({'debug': True}, {'APP_DEBUG': 'false'})['debug'] is False
assert load_config({'debug': True}, {'APP_DEBUG': '0'})['debug'] is False
assert load_config({'debug': False}, {'APP_DEBUG': '1'})['debug'] is True

# Test defaults not mutated
d = {'port': 80}
load_config(d, {'APP_PORT': '123'})
assert d['port'] == 80

print('All checks passed!')
"
